purpose: t0_decisions_20260925.md §2：探针分析时对 reward=1 补丁单列的事后行为审计；不改原 reward
runner: semantic_control.py（候选补丁作为一个变体，先 git apply 源码段）

commands.cmd: python -m pytest -n0 -q -p no:cacheprovider mypy/test/testcheck.py -k 'TypeEquals' 2>&1 | tail -8; exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}

D=$(mktemp -d); cat > $D/t.py <<'PY'
from typing import Any, Callable, TypeVar
T = TypeVar('T')
U = TypeVar('U')
def bad(x: Any, f: Callable[[U], U]) -> T:
    return x
def bad2() -> T:
    ...
PY
python -m mypy --cache-dir=$D/c  $D/t.py; echo rc=$?

D=$(mktemp -d); cat > $D/t.py <<'PY'
from typing import Any, Callable, TypeVar
from typing_extensions import TypeGuard
T = TypeVar('T')
U = TypeVar('U')
def bad(x: Any, f: Callable[[Any], TypeGuard[U]]) -> T:
    return x
PY
python -m mypy --cache-dir=$D/c  $D/t.py; echo rc=$?
python -m pytest -n0 -q -p no:cacheprovider mypy/test/testcheck.py -k testUnboundTypeVar 2>&1 | tail -3
